messages.subject: [R-sig-ins] Mack Hypothesis
messages.body_plain:
Hey everyone,

This is my first post and I don t really know how am I supposed to ask and
 get/give answers back. I guess I ll just go ahead and spit it out.

Is there an R code or package that tests for the hypothesis of
the stochastic version of Chain Ladder (Mack Model) that is :

1-  Independence between the charges (Ci,j) and (Ci',j)  in the whole
triangle
2-  Conditional linear relation between  E(Ci,j+1)= L * Ci,j in the whole
triangle

There is a sketch of tests in Piterbois et Al.(2002) that i
have developed in Excel but I would feel much more comfortable in doing it
with R.

Thanks,

Fabio

messages.subject: [R-sig-ins] New facility in the package ChainLadder
messages.subject_clean: New facility in the package ChainLadder
messages.body_plain:
Dear list,


Version 0.1.5-0<http://code.google.com/p/chainladder/downloads/list> of the ChainLadder package has been released. I have added the function glmReserve, which implements loss reserving models within the generalized linear model framework following the paper England P. and Verrall R. (1999). You can access this new version from either CRAN or the project host (chainladder<http://code.google.com/p/chainladder/>). Use example("glmReserve") to run the examples and ?glmReserve to read about the details of the function in the documentation.  Thanks.

Regards,

Wayne  Zhang
Statistical Research
CNA
